g.text: ┊ Each vector was checked to have length 1 (§4.1: checked, never fixed), turned into whole numbers by
┊ multiplying by 2^24 (§4.2), and sent to the nearest of 128 fixed groups (§7.1). A group keeps exact
┊ integer totals: the sum S and the count n.
┊ Each record also got a secret random number r_t, and each group a sealed fingerprint C_S of its sum
┊ (§9.3, §9.4). The secrets stay in this process's memory: never shown, never written.
(look at one group before deleting anything)
